description: An ask's answer, waited for: a task's script's (run, token), till it's answered (or withdrawn, or its run's stopped), or timeout seconds (0: as it is now, a poll); a chat's own tools' (session), as long, 600 seconds at most. An answer a chat's model gets so isn't sent it as a message as well.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

session.description: A chat's own ask: the asking chat's session id, from its own tools (their connection's hello as), in place of run and token.

run.description: The asking run's id (BAUDE_TASK_RUN): a task's script's.

timeout.description: How long to wait, in seconds (0: not at all; none: till it's answered).
